definitions.hits: distinct damaging own shell launches aimed at enemy guns that hit one or more enemy guns; splash multiple targets counts once
definitions.denominator: all non-slow own launches whose current target at release is enemy artillery; all arrivals traced; global ability gate off
definitions.dodge: successful native dodgeGoal returns, not unique shells or dash reflexes
definitions.outcome: elimination iff enemy=0, own>=1, t<150; timeout iff t>=150
